name: Truist Enjoy Beyond Credit Card

apr.notes: 18.99% to 27.99% variable APR. Cash advance APR 27.99% (Prime plus 20.99%).

base_rate.description: 1x points on all other eligible purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: A Loyalty Cash Bonus based on the Truist deposit relationship applies when cash rewards are redeemed into a Truist deposit account.

signup_bonus.description: 30,000 bonus points after spending $1,500 on purchases within 90 days of account opening.

benefits.title: Annual travel experience credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 annual statement credit for items such as ground transport, streaming services and ticket agencies.

benefits.title: TSA PreCheck or Global Entry credit
benefits.description: Statement credit of up to $120 for the TSA PreCheck or Global Entry fee once every four years.

notes: The product page links both Visa Signature and Visa Traditional benefit guides, so the package depends on the account and network_tier is none.
